Because the cluster carries no fields_or_signature data and no shared structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots, and shared_ancestor are all null), there is no grounded basis to conclude these extensions share meaningful content rather than merely extending the same Apple framework type for locally divergent purposes. The structural signal is a name collision on a system type, not evidence of duplicated logic. Consolidating them would couple unrelated packages around a framework convenience with no demonstrated shared body.
